# CONTROLLER: switch, random_list, if, etc; some function which allows effects inside it.

parse_type_flag_complex = { # parse_type_flag_complex = {TYPE, KEY, APPLY, FLAG}
	$TYPE$_hypercomplex = {
		CONTROLLER = switch

		PRESTATEMENT_ARG = $FLAG$
		PREFIX = "flag:"
		SUFFIX = ""

		EXTRA_ARG = "#"
	}
}

		CONTROLLER = if

		EXTRA_ARG = "#"
	}
}
